净值已扣双边交易成本 10.0 bp（换手率 × 费率）；多空/十分层均含停牌股剔除（收益为 NaN 不参与）。
设计意图： The payoff-first parent remains primary: underwater drawdown depth combined with repeated lower-wick recovery identifies absorption and preserves the parent's positive payoff and monotonicity evidence. The secondary parent contributes only one bounded modifier, drawdown-conditioned downside tail fragility, which attenuates absorption when downside shocks dominate upside energy during local drawdow

因子路由 / 公式 ⚠ FE DSL 暂不支持

[drawdown_depth_50 × ts_mean(16, lower_wick_fraction × close_location)] / [1 + downside_damage_12] × [1 - 0.25 × max(0, drawdown-conditioned tail_fragility_20)]
依赖列: open, high, low, close, volume

📚 字段与算子释义

输入字段

字段含义说明
open开盘价基础行情字段
high最高价基础行情字段
low最低价基础行情字段
close收盘价基础行情字段
volume成交量基础行情字段
close_location收盘位置收盘位置
downside_damage_1212日下行损伤12日下行损伤
drawdown_depth_5050% 回撤深度回撤深度达到 50% 级别的度量
lower_wick_fraction下影线占比下影线 / 振幅（相对下影线比例）
tail_fragility_2020 日尾部脆弱性基于尾部事件的脆弱度度量

算子

算子含义
ts_meants_mean(x, n) → 滚动均值
maxmax(x, n) → 滚动最大 / 逐点最大

🔬 陌生算子/字段释义

算子/字段含义
power计算 x 的 y 次方
ts_pctd 期变化率：(x − x_shift(d)) / x_shift(d)

📝 计算步骤（一步一步解释）

  1. 计算 high：high
  2. 计算 low：low
  3. 计算 open_：open
  4. 计算 close：close
  5. 计算 eps：np.finfo(float).eps
  6. 计算 safe_close：close.clip(lower=eps)
  7. 计算 bar_range：(high - low)
  8. 计算 wick_base：np.minimum(open_, close)
  9. 计算 lower_wick：((wick_base - low) / bar_range).clip(lower=0.0, upper=1.0)
  10. 计算 close_location：((close - low) / bar_range).clip(lower=0.0, upper=1.0)
  11. 计算 absorption：(lower_wick * close_location).滚动窗口(16, min_periods=16).mean()
  12. 计算 high_water：safe_close.滚动窗口(50, min_periods=50).max().clip(lower=eps)
  13. 计算 depth：(1.0 - safe_close / high_water).clip(lower=0.0)
  14. 计算 prior_close：safe_close.shift(1)
  15. 计算 downside_damage：(-np.log(safe_close / prior_close)).clip(lower=0.0).滚动窗口(12, min_periods=12).sum()
  16. 计算 ret：safe_close.pct_change()
  17. 计算 downside_energy：ret.clip(upper=0.0).pow(2)
  18. 计算 upside_energy：ret.clip(lower=0.0).pow(2)
  19. 计算 rolling_peak：safe_close.滚动窗口(20, min_periods=20).max().clip(lower=eps)
  20. 计算 local_drawdown：(1.0 - safe_close / rolling_peak).clip(lower=0.0)
  21. 计算 weighted_downside：(downside_energy * (1.0 + local_drawdown)).滚动窗口(20, min_periods=20).mean()
  22. 计算 upside_baseline：upside_energy.滚动窗口(20, min_periods=20).mean()
  23. 计算 total_energy：(downside_energy + upside_energy).滚动窗口(20, min_periods=20).mean()
  24. 计算 tail_fragility：((weighted_downside - upside_baseline) / total_energy).clip(lower=0.0, upper=1.0)
  25. 计算 signal：depth * absorption / (1.0 + downside_damage)
  26. 计算 signal：signal * (1.0 - 0.25 * tail_fragility)

🐍 原始 Python 代码 (factor_delivery)

"kw">class="kw">def factor_drawdown_wick_absorption_tail_guard(df): """Measure underwater lower-wick absorption with bounded drawdown-conditioned tail-risk attenuation.""" df_copy = df.copy() high = df_copy["high"] low = df_copy["low"] open_ = df_copy["open"] close = df_copy["close"].replace([np.inf, -np.inf], np.nan) eps = np.finfo(float).eps safe_close = close.clip(lower=eps) bar_range = (high - low).replace(0.0, np.nan) wick_base = np.minimum(open_, close) lower_wick = ((wick_base - low) / bar_range).clip(lower=0.0, upper=1.0) close_location = ((close - low) / bar_range).clip(lower=0.0, upper=1.0) absorption = (lower_wick * close_location).rolling(16, min_periods=16).mean() high_water = safe_close.rolling(50, min_periods=50).max().clip(lower=eps) depth = (1.0 - safe_close / high_water).clip(lower=0.0) prior_close = safe_close.shift(1) downside_damage = (-np.log(safe_close / prior_close)).clip(lower=0.0).rolling(12, min_periods=12).sum() ret = safe_close.pct_change().replace([np.inf, -np.inf], np.nan) downside_energy = ret.clip(upper=0.0).pow(2) upside_energy = ret.clip(lower=0.0).pow(2) rolling_peak = safe_close.rolling(20, min_periods=20).max().clip(lower=eps) local_drawdown = (1.0 - safe_close / rolling_peak).clip(lower=0.0) weighted_downside = (downside_energy * (1.0 + local_drawdown)).rolling(20, min_periods=20).mean() upside_baseline = upside_energy.rolling(20, min_periods=20).mean() total_energy = (downside_energy + upside_energy).rolling(20, min_periods=20).mean().replace(0.0, np.nan) tail_fragility = ((weighted_downside - upside_baseline) / total_energy).clip(lower=0.0, upper=1.0) signal = depth * absorption / (1.0 + downside_damage) signal = signal * (1.0 - 0.25 * tail_fragility) df_copy["factor_drawdown_wick_absorption_tail_guard"] = signal.replace([np.inf, -np.inf], np.nan) "kw">class="kw">return df_copy["factor_drawdown_wick_absorption_tail_guard"]
